name: Historic Centre of Oaxaca and Archaeological Site of Monte Albán
description: In southern Mexico's Oaxaca valley, this site pairs a colonial city with an ancient mountaintop capital. Monte Albán, founded around 500 BC, is a Zapotec ceremonial centre of pyramids, plazas and terraces on a ridge levelled by hand, about 400 metres above the valley. Nine kilometres east, Oaxaca's gridded streets are lined with thick, sturdy buildings made to withstand earthquakes.
